paper: Seeing What Matters: Generalizable AI-generated Video Detection with Forensic-Oriented Augmentation (WaveRep, Corvi, Cozzolino, Prashnani, De Mello, Nagano, Verdoliva, NeurIPS 2025, arXiv 2506.16802)
training_set_in_paper: The paper's main detector is trained on ONE generator (Pyramid Flow) and Table 5 adds CogVideoX 1.5, Allegro and Open-Sora Plan. The official demo README only says that weights_dinov2_G1.ckpt (key waverep) is trained on "a single generator" and weights_dinov2_G4.ckpt (key waverep_g4, the demo's default) on "four generators"; reading G1 as the paper's Pyramid Flow detector and G4 as the Pyramid Flow + CogVideoX 1.5 + Allegro + Open-Sora Plan set of Table 5 is our inference, not stated in the release. Both are the official checkpoints (no training code released for the model; only the augmentation), so there is no SynthScope-trained number. Metrics: balanced accuracy at 0.5 and AUC (Tables 1-2 and 7); video score = mean logit of the first 64 frames, center-cropped to 504 (App. D). The paper's own test set (7 generators vs 300 Panda-70M YouTube reals) is NOT held: the reals need a YouTube downloader and were not scraped. The only paper-comparable numbers here are the paper's 8 GenVideo columns, scored on GenVideo-Val with its own 10,000 reals (the paper does not say which reals it paired). Everything else is a zero-shot reference row, not a paper reproduction. Protocol is the same for every row: official OpenCV reader, first 64 frames, 504 centre crop, mean logit, threshold logit 0; exact parity with the official demo (15 videos / 6 codecs: inputs bit-exact, video logit max diff 6e-7; 180 GenVideo-Val files, both checkpoints: max |logit diff| 1.05e-5, 0 sign flips).

benchmarks.name: GenVideo-Val, the paper's 8 GenVideo generators (reference only: G4 is not the paper's single-generator model)
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy at 0.5 and AUC, mean over the paper's 8 GenVideo columns (full GenVideo-Val, 64 frames)
benchmarks.paper_per_generator: No paper cell: Table 5 trains G4 on four generators and reports other test sets. The paper's G1 per-generator values are in the waverep spec.

our_number.note: REFERENCE ONLY: G4 is trained on four generators, not the paper's single-generator setting (the paper's G1 values are in the waverep rows). PARTIAL as for G1: GenVideo-Val's own 10,000 reals (the paper's pairing is unstated). Above the paper's G1 on every column but Gen2 AUC, by up to 4.7 bAcc (Show-1).
